'''Mr. Norris''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN032|Time After Time!]]''. He did not receive a name in the Japanese version.

Mr. Norris is the caretaker of a cottage in [[Azalea Town]]. Mr. Norris was working with {{p|Sunflora}} when [[Walker]] and [[Camille]] arrived with [[Goh]] for a holiday. Mr. Norris greeted them, having met them three years earlier when they had used the same cottage. Mr. Norris gave them the key to the cottage and wished them a good time.
